Name: Limp Sword Flag
Details: May units receive the Limp Sword Flag over time, often after successful major wars against House Liao, like the Fourth Succession War. The Limp Sword Flag is granted in acknowledgement of a successful action in which a heavy blow was struck against the Capellan Confederation. The Limp Sword Flag is a smashed BattleMech hand holding a drooping sword, set against an inverted green triangle on a black background. It was originally created by a soldier defacing a 'Mech they had destroyed with a symbol mocking the CCAF, and insulting the reigning Chancellor at the same time over his inability to sire children.
